tests.scope: Actual RunStatistics and SQLite score persistence/version ranks, client network contracts with local worker, async UI version/save races and text escaping, real Game outcome rendering, authored 50-wave identity mapping and gameplay/RNG immutability.

implementation.selection: Deterministic by final wave; canonical campaign names, including composite wave38 and Lord Bernhard on wave50.
implementation.victory: Separate final-Bernhard and historical short-campaign victory chronicles.
implementation.factsPreserved: Existing run event observer and factual progress/score/time/kills remain unchanged; only the old Recorded final wave facts section is replaced.
implementation.scoreVersionDefault: Immutable played run version from client.tracker.version, falling back to current GAME_VERSION for markup.
implementation.versionNavigation: Exact edition requests only; numeric sorting, current selection, focus preservation, rejected all/mixed-version responses and stale async response guards.
implementation.saveForm: Before Top 10 commanders; saving always ranks the immutable played edition and returns that edition to view.
implementation.scoreRetention: Existing rows, versions, schema and API remain intact; no database migration or deletion; local worker/SQLite tests verify older score rows byte-value unchanged and exact per-version ranks.
implementation.backendCompatibility: Existing exact-version endpoint is used. Legacy all-version API remains available for existing external consumers; the game and standalone public UI do not offer it.
implementation.privacy: Name validation and DOM text-only public rows retained; no new telemetry, identity fields or network endpoints.

deployment.standaloneServicePage: Source updated to default current edition and reject mismatched versions. External score-service deployment was not changed or attempted.

protectedMechanics: No combat/draft/renderer/release/main/header/score calculation changes. Only the explicitly authorized network presentation client within game/core was edited.
integrationNote: A broader earlier check found the root-owned main transport fixture needed its new combatTransport binding; root was notified. This is outside these result/score files.
